name: IDIOTS
description: Idiots (better known as Shithead, Palace, or Karma) is a widespread shedding-type card game. The goal is to avoid being the last player with cards, as that person is declared the 'Idiot' (Shithead). It features a unique three-layered hand structure and several 'magic' cards that can reset, skip, or burn the discard pile.

content.text: Idiots (better known as Shithead, Palace, or Karma) is a widespread shedding-type card game. The goal is to avoid being the last player with cards, as that person is declared the 'Idiot' (Shithead). It features a unique three-layered hand structure and several 'magic' cards that can reset, skip, or burn the discard pile.
Likely originated in Scandinavia in the mid-20th century spread by backpackers and students. It gained popularity globally in the 1970s and 80s.
One deck for up to 4 players, two decks for 5+.
One deck for up to 4 players, two decks for 5+.

1. Deal 3 cards face-down to each player (Blind cards).
2. Deal 3 cards face-up on top of them (Table cards).
3. Deal 3 cards to each player's hand.
4. Players can swap hand cards with their face-up Table cards before play begins.

items.text: Jokers: Two Jokers are added as special cards that reverse the direction of play and allow up to six players. In some variants a Joker may be played at any time; when played, the waste pile is given to another player (opponent in two-player; chooser in multiplayer).

Stacking: When rearranging before play, players may stack cards of the same rank on top of each other on the upcard piles and replenish the hand from stock; this may be done more than once if more cards can be stacked.
Tens Restricted: Tens may not be played on face cards; a player who plays a 10 may take another turn immediately.
Transparency: In one variant 8s are transparent and play is based on the card below; in others the 3 has this role instead.
